## Description

The [Herbarium of New Caledonia](http://publish.plantnet-project.org/project/nou) (NOU) is located at the French National Research Institute for Sustainable Development (IRD) centre in Nouméa and is managed by the AMAP lab (Bruy 2023). It was refurbished in 2024, almost doubling its floor area. It holds more than 100,000 specimens representing about 7,000 species. Most specimens come from New Caledonia, but the collection also includes specimens from 15 other Pacific countries and territories, including many from Vanuatu and Wallis and Futuna, and some from Fiji and the Solomon Islands.

All specimens are databased, digitised at high resolution and [available online](http://publish.plantnet-project.org/project/nou). The checklist of New Caledonian plant species is regularly updated through [Florical](http://publish.plantnet-project.org/project/florical_fr) (Morat et al. 2012).

## Herbarium team

David Bruy, Nathan Eltabet, Jacqueline Fambart-Tinel and Emmanuelle Vanhalle.
